name: SmokeMeasureReview
title: Smoke — PAT-262 measure review (reviewers, decisions, comment threads)
description: Raw draft MeasureDefinition (POST /api/measures). The owner assigns the seeded demo user as reviewer, a comment thread is opened / replied / resolved, demo requests changes (back to draft), the author resubmits, demo approves the decision and then the measure.
cqlContent:
library SmokeMeasureReview version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<DateTime>

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 18
